events.label: dribble_goal_score
events.what: The player dribbles past the defender and scores a goal.

events.label: clutch_line_save
events.what: The player flips backwards to clear the ball right off the goal line.

events.label: fast_break_goal
events.what: The player drives the ball downfield into the open net.

events.label: opponent_demolition
events.what: The player rams into the opponent car at full speed, causing a demolition.

events.label: open_net_goal
events.what: The player capitalizes on an opponent mistake to score an easy goal.

events.label: power_shot_goal
events.what: The player hits a high-velocity shot straight into the opponent net.

events.label: clutch_demolition_goal
events.what: The player demolishes the opponent and scores into the empty net.

events.label: funny_own_goal
events.what: The player panics and accidentally hits the ball directly into their own net.

events.label: long_range_shot
events.what: The player launches a long-range shot into the opponent's goal.

events.label: kickoff_counter_goal
events.what: The player takes advantage off the kickoff and scores a quick goal.

events.label: aerial_wall_shot
events.what: The player hits the ball off the wall and scores a clean goal.

events.label: ground_pinch_goal
events.what: The player pinches the ball off the ground into the top corner of the net.

events.label: match_point_goal
events.what: The player hits a final shot past the opponent to score.
